item.title: Crookston downtown snow removal postponed

item.title: City of Crookston to collect real Christmas trees
item.description: The City of Crookston Public Works department will be conducting Christmas Tree pickup from January 5-16. Please place your tree on the berm to have your tree collected. If you have any questions, please reach out to Public Works at (218) 281-1232.
